subject: Connecting on Niemann-Pick C support efforts
body:
Dear INPDA team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group for Niemann-Pick C, a disease that affects my own family.

I understand that INPDA is a global network of non-profit organisations supporting persons affected by Niemann-Pick diseases [Eaff0524]. Given that our communities share this focus, I believe there may be valuable opportunities for us to learn from one another and support families together.

I would be glad to arrange a short call, at your convenience, simply to introduce our group and hear more about INPDA's work, with an eye toward exploring whether closer collaboration might benefit the families we both serve.

Thank you for considering this, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader, Niemann-Pick C Patient Group

Sources:
[Eaff0524] https://www.inpda.org/about-us/
